title: tell implementers in the brief that CLI socket tests may only fail in their sandbox and that ork's round check is the evidence

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The gate reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261120-001408-907b, project ork, item S353:

tell implementers in the brief that CLI socket tests may only fail in their sandbox and that ork's round check is the evidence

Evidence: implementer-2 reported 322 sandbox failures (setsockopt/connect not permitted), while ork's checks-2.log and my focused run were green
